# Refactoring.Guru for Gemini CLI

Generated by scripts/build-targets.mjs from plugins/refactoring-guru/ in the guided-plugins repository.

Install from a checkout of the repository (Gemini installs one extension per repository from GitHub, so use the local path):

```bash
gemini extensions install ./dist/gemini/refactoring-guru
```

Gemini asks you to confirm before it installs (trust and consent prompts).

- 36 skills (including 6 mode skills). Gemini's documentation says each is also a slash command `/refactoring-guru:refactoring-guru-<name>`; that was not exercised in a live session here.
- 22 subagents, started with `@refactoring-guru-<name> <task>`.
